decision.question: Compared with the source image, has the image been transformed into a drawing made from chalk, rather than only receiving a partial chalk-like effect?
decision.criteria: Pass if the edited image as a whole reads as a chalk-made drawing in comparison with the source, with the transformation sufficiently carried through the depicted scene; fail if it remains substantially photographic or shows only a partial chalk-like treatment. Do not require any particular color palette or specific chalk technique. Unknown if the source or edited image is unavailable or visual evidence is insufficient to judge.
decision.binding: Compare the source and edited images to assess whether the requested chalk-drawing transformation is complete, not merely whether some chalk-like texture or shading is visible.
